title: Transition probability
statement: Let $G$ be a regular multigraph of degree $D$ on a vertex type $V$. For vertices $u,v\in V$ and an integer $k\ge 0$, the transition probability is the index-sampling probability that the endpoint reached from $u$ by index choice $w$ equals $v$.
hypotheses_covered: A regular multigraph on V of natural-number degree D
Vertices u and v in V
caveat: The definition of the index-sampling probability and the endpoint map are not included in the supplied definitions.
